content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: XQL(EMAIL-002 Malicious Attachment Blocked By TAP) OR XQL(EMAIL-002 Malicious Attachment Microsoft 365 EmailEvents Shape) FOLLOWED_BY xdr_data file or process with the same sha256 for the recipient within 2h
rules.name: Malicious Attachment Delivered Then Endpoint Detonation — Email to Endpoint Stitch
